name: Robinhood
description: Connect your Robinhood Agentic account for market research, portfolio management, and trading.

methods.whenToUse: Use the provider-hosted connection for the quickest setup.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to Robinhood and complete Agentic account onboarding. Reads can include your other Robinhood accounts; trades are limited by Robinhood to the dedicated Agentic account. Choose which agents and actions may use this connection in Permissions. Connecting does not place any orders.
methods.label: Sign in with Robinhood
warnings: Sign in on a desktop browser and complete Robinhood Agentic account onboarding. Trading is limited to the dedicated Agentic account.
